newsitem.title: UK: NWE GAS OIL SLIPS $3.00 WITH FUTURES, PREMS HOLD.
newsitem.headline: NWE GAS OIL SLIPS $3.00 WITH FUTURES, PREMS HOLD.

text.p: NWE gas oil fell nearly $3.00 a tonne on Thursday as IPE futures slipped in a catch-up to Brent crude's losses on Wednesday. Premiums were broadly steady.
August gas oil closed at $172.50, down $2.75 a tonne.
Heating oil barges were assessed around +75 cents and +$1.00 fob Rotterdam against August IPE for first half August delivery and about 25 cents stronger for second half of August delivery.
EN590 barge differentials were pegged flat at August +$4.50-5.50. Some dealers said bidds were down as low as $3.50-4.00.
Expectations of at least 80,000 tonnes of Russian 0.2 pct grade arriving in NWE has kept a lid on premiums rising in NWE.
